exemptions.name: origin
exemptions.reason: Provenance of an image (bundled with the app or uploaded by the user), not a property of the character or a category the user selects.
exemptions.approvedBy: FP-06+07 planner under Eric's 2026-11-18 delegation (all gates self-approved)

exemptions.name: source
exemptions.reason: Provenance of the profile text (generated by the summoner or typed by the user), so a manual fallback is never shown as AI generation; not a character category.
exemptions.approvedBy: FP-06+07 planner under Eric's 2026-11-18 delegation (all gates self-approved)

exemptions.name: status
exemptions.reason: Lifecycle state of one generation request (queued, running, ready, failed, cancelled, accepted, superseded), not a property of any Specter.
exemptions.approvedBy: FP-06+07 planner under Eric's 2026-11-18 delegation (all gates self-approved)

exemptions.name: heroId
exemptions.reason: The identifier of one of 11 fixed, authored, cosmetic characters (Eric's art). It selects no behaviour, role, capability, lane or tier, and the closed list is the roster itself, so a twelfth hero needs a new migration and a v3 contract.
exemptions.approvedBy: FP-16 planner under Eric's 2026-11-17 delegation (all gates self-approved)

exemptions.name: sizeClass
exemptions.reason: A display size bucket of one task's observed run time (small, medium, large), named by the PA-3 shared contract so the arena can scale minion art. It is not a bot or Specter class: it classifies a task, selects no behaviour, role or capability, is never stored, and is derived on each read from runMs.
exemptions.approvedBy: FP-22 backend worker building to the orchestrator's shared contract, under Eric's 2026-11-17 delegation (all gates self-approved)
